a: Goodbye in French is Au revoir.
Goodbye in Spanish is Adiós or Hasta luego.
Goodbye in Arabic is Ma'a as-salama (مع السلامة).
Goodbye in Mandarin is 再见 (Zàijiàn).
Goodbye in Hindi is अलविदा (Alvida) or फिर मिलेंगे.
Goodbye in Portuguese is Tchau or Adeus.
Goodbye in German is Auf Wiedersehen or Tschüss.
Goodbye in Japanese is さようなら (Sayounara) or またね.
Goodbye in Korean is 안녕히 가세요 (leaving) / 안녕히 계세요 (staying).
